scoring.match: one-to-one maximum matching; same kind, same method (or one of the key item acceptMethods), compatible crops (both absent, or sharing a crop), equal distanceFt / windMinMph / windMaxMph, key prohibitions only by extracted prohibitions, page within +-1 of the key pdf_page (verified page, else claimed page); key items with identical kind, method, crops, numbers, prohibited flag and page count once
scoring.recall: answer-key restrictions with a distance or wind number that were matched / all of them
scoring.precision: extracted restrictions with a distance or wind number that match an answer-key item by the match rule (a repeat of an already matched key item counts as correct) / all extracted restrictions with a distance or wind number. A clause whose sentence is a key sentence but whose kind, method, crops or number disagree is wrong; a clause found in the PDF whose sentence is not in the key is not credited (see notInKey)
scoring.verifiedQuoteRate: extracted restrictions whose quote was found in the PDF text layer (findQuote) / all extracted restrictions
scoring.prohibitions: answer-key crop prohibitions matched by an extracted prohibition / key prohibitions (only the BUILD_SPEC-named ones are keyed; see eval/ANNOTATION.md)
scoring.notInKey: extracted distance or wind clauses found in the PDF whose sentence is not in the answer key; counted as not correct in precision and listed in extras
scoring.unmatchedProhibitions: extracted prohibitions without a number that match no key prohibition; no ratio scores them, so they are counted here and listed in extras
